comments.text: Spawn Protection: Wire Player Spawned in. Call End Spawn Protection from Weapon Fired to end it as soon as they shoot. Bots get it too (and don't know they have it).
Lives Counter: Wire Round Started into Reset Lives (For Each Player), and Player Killed's victim into Lose a Life; on Out, keep them dead or move them to spectators. Bots count lives like anyone.
Burn, Slow and Freeze: Call one from a hit, a trap or an ability. Each ends by itself; Slow puts the speed back to 250. Bots: they keep clear of a burning player while it burns.
Burn uses Set On Fire's own timer; Seconds and Damage a second are its settings (wire them in to change them per call).
Kill Streak Announcer: Wire Player Killed in (Killer = attacker, Victim = victim). Streak is the killer's count after this kill. Bots' streaks are announced too.
Countdown HUD: Wire Round Started (or Freeze Time Ended) in. Label goes before the time (empty: Time left); it stops at 0 and runs Done. Bots don't read it.
Leaderboard Display: Save the score with Add To Saved (the same Key) as players earn it, then call this from a say command, a key or the round's end. Bots are on it like anyone; they don't open it.
Show Leaderboard: the Key is Top Players' setting (kills); change it to the key your mode saves.

Capture Zone: Make Capture Zone at an entity; Point Captured runs when a team takes it (end the round there, or score). The time and size are the Create Component keys inside (time=10, radius=160): change them there. Bots: the zone is a capture goal for every bot.
Kill Cam: Wire Player Killed in (Victim, Killer). Nothing for a suicide or a fall. Bots get it too (it doesn't change what they do).
Victory Camera: Wire it where your mode picks a winner (before End Round). Winner is the player to show. Bots' views move too.

Quest Step Tracker: Set Quest Step when a talk ends (Run Dialog's Last row) or a task is done; Quest Step Of tells where a player is (empty: not started). Quest Done marks the end. Bots never start quests.
